caption:
I pushed the pull door

i pushed the pull door. everyone saw. (nobody was looking)

For whoever is still thinking about that one time.

The theory: the spotlight effect, we think others notice our slips far more than they do (Gilovich, Medvec and Savitsky, 2000, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology). An example, not a diagnosis.

#Cella

alt: A short film with no voice. A pink hallway with a door that has a small PULL plate. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes walks to the door and pushes it, leaning in. The door shivers a little without opening, and the figure bounces back a step, eyes wide. It looks left, right, up and at the camera, shrinks a little and squints. The hallway is empty. Then it relaxes, pulses with happy eyes and goes on. The text stays: i pushed the pull door, everyone saw, (nobody was looking).
